entries.title: Genesis 36:1
segments: ¶Now this [is] the genealogy of Esau, who is Edom.

entries.title: Genesis 36:2
segments: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite; Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;

entries.title: Genesis 36:3
segments: and Basemath, Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.

entries.title: Genesis 36:4
segments: Now Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel.

entries.title: Genesis 36:5
segments: And Aholibamah bore Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah. These [were] the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 36:6
segments: Then Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the persons of his household, his cattle and all his animals, and all his goods which he had gained in the land of Canaan, and went to a country away from the presence of his brother Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 36:7
segments: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together, and the land where they were strangers could not support them because of their livestock.

entries.title: Genesis 36:8
segments: So Esau dwelt in Mount Seir. Esau [is] Edom.

entries.title: Genesis 36:9
segments: ¶And this [is] the genealogy of Esau the father of the Edomites in Mount Seir.

entries.title: Genesis 36:10
segments: These [were] the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, and Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.

entries.title: Genesis 36:11
segments: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

entries.title: Genesis 36:12
segments: Now Timna was the concubine of Eliphaz, Esau's son, and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These [were] the sons of Adah, Esau's wife.

entries.title: Genesis 36:13
segments: These [were] the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.

entries.title: Genesis 36:14
segments: These were the sons of Aholibamah, Esau's wife, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon. And she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah.

entries.title: Genesis 36:15
segments: These [were] the chiefs of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn [son] of Esau, were Chief Teman, Chief Omar, Chief Zepho, Chief Kenaz,

entries.title: Genesis 36:16
segments: Chief Korah, Chief Gatam, [and] Chief Amalek. These [were] the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. They [were] the sons of Adah.

entries.title: Genesis 36:17
segments: These [were] the sons of Reuel, Esau's son: Chief Nahath, Chief Zerah, Chief Shammah, and Chief Mizzah. These [were] the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom. These [were] the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.

entries.title: Genesis 36:18
segments: And these [were] the sons of Aholibamah, Esau's wife: Chief Jeush, Chief Jaalam, and Chief Korah. These [were] the chiefs [who descended] from Aholibamah, Esau's wife, the daughter of Anah.

entries.title: Genesis 36:19
segments: These [were] the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these [were] their chiefs.

entries.title: Genesis 36:20
segments: ¶These [were] the sons of Seir the Horite who inhabited the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

entries.title: Genesis 36:21
segments: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These [were] the chiefs of the Horites, the sons of Seir, in the land of Edom.

entries.title: Genesis 36:22
segments: And the sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Lotan's sister [was] Timna.

entries.title: Genesis 36:23
segments: These [were] the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

entries.title: Genesis 36:24
segments: These [were] the sons of Zibeon: both Ajah and Anah. This [was the] Anah who found the water in the wilderness as he pastured the donkeys of his father Zibeon.

entries.title: Genesis 36:25
segments: These [were] the children of Anah: Dishon and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

entries.title: Genesis 36:26
segments: These [were] the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

entries.title: Genesis 36:27
segments: These [were] the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

entries.title: Genesis 36:28
segments: These [were] the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

entries.title: Genesis 36:29
segments: These [were] the chiefs of the Horites: Chief Lotan, Chief Shobal, Chief Zibeon, Chief Anah,

entries.title: Genesis 36:30
segments: Chief Dishon, Chief Ezer, and Chief Dishan. These [were] the chiefs of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

entries.title: Genesis 36:31
segments: ¶Now these [were] the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel:

entries.title: Genesis 36:32
segments: Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city [was] Dinhabah.

entries.title: Genesis 36:33
segments: And when Bela died, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

entries.title: Genesis 36:34
segments: When Jobab died, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

entries.title: Genesis 36:35
segments: And when Husham died, Hadad the son of Bedad, who attacked Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city [was] Avith.

entries.title: Genesis 36:36
segments: When Hadad died, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

entries.title: Genesis 36:37
segments: And when Samlah died, Saul of Rehoboth-[by] -the-River reigned in his place.

entries.title: Genesis 36:38
segments: When Saul died, Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

entries.title: Genesis 36:39
segments: And when Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor died, Hadar reigned in his place; and the name of his city [was] Pau. His wife's name [was] Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

entries.title: Genesis 36:40
segments: And these [were] the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their families and their places, by their names: Chief Timnah, Chief Alvah, Chief Jetheth,

entries.title: Genesis 36:41
segments: Chief Aholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,

entries.title: Genesis 36:42
segments: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,

entries.title: Genesis 36:43
segments: Chief Magdiel, and Chief Iram. These [were] the chiefs of Edom, according to their dwelling places in the land of their possession. Esau [was] the father of the Edomites.
